children: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on August 28 that the outcome of the war proved U.S. bases in neighboring countries cannot protect those countries' security, that those bases were designed from the start to "protect Israel," and that Iran's strikes on them were a response to U.S. aggression.

title: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi Says U.S. Bases in Neighboring Countries Are Legitimate Targets
